source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 14 (PDF 18-44), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 (Simple Harmonic Motion) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Simple harmonic motion is a special type of oscillatory motion in which a restoring force always pulls the object:
(Simple harmonic motion aik khaas oscillatory motion hai jis mein restoring force jism ko hamesha kis taraf khenchti hai?)
blocks.explanation: S.H.M mein restoring force (wapas laane wali quwwat) jism ko hamesha mean position (darmiyani maqaam) ki taraf wapas khenchti hai.

book_ref.quote: a special type of oscillatory motion where a restoring force always pulls the object back

blocks.prompt:
2 Which of the following is given in the chapter as an example of periodic motion in nature?
(Chapter mein qudrat ki periodic motion ki misaal kaun si di gayi hai?)

options.text: Chaand ka Zameen ke gird chakkar

blocks.explanation: Zameen ka Suraj ke gird aur Chaand ka Zameen ke gird chakkar qudrati periodic (dohrane wali) motion hai.

book_ref.quote: Like motion of Earth around the Sun, The motion of moon around the Earth

blocks.prompt:
3 Oscillatory motion is best described as:
(Oscillatory motion ki behtareen tareef kya hai?)

options.text: yaksaan speed se seedhi line mein motion
aisi motion jo kabhi na dohraye
sirf fixed axis ke gird gardish
mean position ke gird aage peeche ki periodic motion

blocks.explanation: Oscillatory motion mean position ke ird gird aage peeche ki motion hai jo barabar waqfon ke baad dohrati hai (14.1).

book_ref.quote: Oscillatory motion is a to and fro motion about its mean position

blocks.prompt:
4 When sound waves travel through air, the air molecules:
(Jab sound waves hawa mein safar karti hain to hawa ke molecules kya karte hain?)

options.text: wave ke saath sunne wale tak chale jaate hain
apni mean position ke gird oscillate karte hain

blocks.explanation: Sound waves guzarne par hawa ke molecules apni mean position ke gird oscillate (jhoolna) karte hain (14.1).

book_ref.quote: Air molecules oscillate when sound waves travel through air.

blocks.prompt:
5 When an oscillating body is displaced from its mean position, the force that brings it back is called:
(Jab oscillate karne wala jism mean position se hataya jaye to usay wapas laane wali force ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Restoring force (wapas laane wali quwwat) hataye gaye jism ko equilibrium position par wapas laati hai (14.1).

book_ref.quote: then there is restoring force which brings it back to its equilibrium position

blocks.prompt:
6 One complete round trip (cycle) of a vibrating body about its mean position is called:
(Vibrate karne wale jism ka mean position ke gird aik mukammal chakkar (cycle) kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mean position ke gird aik mukammal chakkar aik vibration (thartharahat) kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: One complete round trip (cycle) of vibrating body about its mean position is called vibration

blocks.prompt:
7 For a pendulum swinging between extreme positions A and B, one vibration is the motion:
(Extreme positions A aur B ke darmiyan jhoolte pendulum ki aik vibration kaun si motion hai?)

options.text: A se B aur wapas A tak

blocks.explanation: Bob ka A se B aur phir B se wapas A tak jaana aik vibration hai.

book_ref.quote: motion of bob of pendulum from A to B and back from B to A is one vibration

blocks.prompt:
8 The distance of a vibrating body from its mean position at any instant is called:
(Kisi bhi lamhe vibrate karne wale jism ka mean position se faasla kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi lamhe mean position se faasla instantaneous displacement (lamhati haqeeqi faasla) x kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: The distance of a vibrating body from its mean position at any instant, is called instantaneous displacement

blocks.prompt:
9 The magnitude of the maximum displacement of a vibrating body on either side of its mean position is its:
(Mean position ke kisi bhi taraf vibrate karne wale jism ke zyada se zyada displacement ki miqdaar kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude (dhamak) x₀ mean position ke kisi bhi taraf zyada se zyada displacement ki miqdaar hai.

book_ref.quote: The magnitude of the maximum displacement of the vibrating body on either side of its mean position

blocks.prompt:
10 According to the chapter, a wave of greater amplitude carries:
(Chapter ke mutabiq zyada amplitude wali wave kitni energy le jaati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude wave ki energy ka paimana hai: amplitude zyada to energy zyada.

book_ref.quote: The greater the amplitude of the wave, greater will be the energy carried by the wave

blocks.prompt:
11 A pendulum has amplitude 6 cm. The distance covered by the bob in one complete vibration is:
(Aik pendulum ka amplitude 6 cm hai. Aik mukammal vibration mein bob kitna faasla tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik vibration mein bob 4 dafa amplitude ke barabar chalta hai: 4x₀ = 4 × 6 cm = 24 cm.

book_ref.quote: If x₀ is the amplitude of simple pendulum

blocks.prompt:
12 The time taken to complete one vibration is called:
(Aik vibration mukammal karne mein lagne wala waqt kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik vibration ka waqt time period (waqt-e-dauraan) T kehlata hai; SI unit second hai.

book_ref.quote: Time period is defined as the time taken to complete one vibration or one cycle

blocks.prompt:
13 A body completes 12 vibrations in 3 s. Its frequency is:
(Aik jism 3 s mein 12 vibrations karta hai. Us ki frequency kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Frequency is defined as the number of vibrations or oscillations (n) completed by the vibrating body in one second

blocks.prompt:
14 A body on a spring makes 12 vibrations in 3 s. Its time period is:
(Spring par laga jism 3 s mein 12 vibrations karta hai. Us ka time period kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: f = 12/3 = 4 Hz, is liye T = 1/f = 0.25 s.

book_ref.quote: A fish connected to a spring makes 10 vibrations in 20 seconds

blocks.prompt:
15 One hertz is defined as:
(Aik hertz ki definition kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Frequency ki unit hertz hai; aik hertz yani aik oscillation fi second.

book_ref.quote: One hertz is defined as one oscillation per second

blocks.prompt:
16 The dimension of frequency is:
(Frequency ki dimension kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Frequency = 1/T, is liye dimension [T⁻¹] hai.

book_ref.quote: The dimension of frequency is [T⁻¹].

blocks.prompt:
17 Angular displacement per unit time is called:
(Fi unit waqt angular displacement ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: ω = θ/t: fi unit waqt angular displacement angular frequency (zaaviyai frequency) hai.

book_ref.quote: Angular displacement per unit time is called angular frequency

blocks.prompt:
18 The SI unit of angular frequency is:
(Angular frequency ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angular frequency ki SI unit rad s⁻¹ aur dimension [T⁻¹] hai.

book_ref.quote: The SI unit of angular frequency is rad s⁻¹ and its dimension is [T⁻¹].

blocks.prompt:
19 A body vibrates with frequency 5 Hz. Its angular frequency is about:
(Aik jism 5 Hz frequency se vibrate karta hai. Us ki angular frequency taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: ω = 2πf = 2π × 5 = 31.4 rad s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: Now for one revolution θ = 2π radian

blocks.prompt:
20 The time period T is related to the angular frequency ω by:
(Time period T aur angular frequency ω ka taalluq kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: Time period in terms of frequency f and angular frequency ω is expressed as:

blocks.prompt:
21 A particle in S.H.M has angular frequency 4 rad s⁻¹. Its time period is about:
(S.H.M karne wale particle ki angular frequency 4 rad s⁻¹ hai. Us ka time period taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: T = 2π/ω = 2π/4 = 1.57 s (frequency 0.637 Hz).

book_ref.quote: A particle executing simple harmonic motion has an angular frequency of 2 rad s⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
22 A particle in S.H.M has angular frequency 4 rad s⁻¹. Its frequency is about:
(S.H.M karne wale particle ki angular frequency 4 rad s⁻¹ hai. Us ki frequency taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The frequency is approximately 0.318 Hz, and the time period is approximately 3 seconds.

blocks.prompt:
23 Which of these is NOT listed as an example of oscillatory motion?
(In mein se kaun si oscillatory motion ki misaal NAHI hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tuning fork, jhoola aur parindon ke par oscillation ki misalein hain; seedhi line mein goli aage peeche nahi hoti.

book_ref.quote: The wings of birds during flying.

blocks.prompt:
24 Simple harmonic motion is a type of:
(Simple harmonic motion kis qisam ki motion hai?)

options.text: constant velocity se seedhi line mein motion

blocks.explanation: S.H.M aik qisam ki oscillation ya vibratory (thartharahat wali) motion hai jo restoring force se paida hoti hai (14.2).

book_ref.quote: Simple harmonic motion is a type of oscillation or vibratory motion produced under the action of restoring force.

blocks.prompt:
25 For S.H.M, the restoring force must be:
(S.H.M ke liye restoring force kaisi honi chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Zaroori shart: restoring force mean position se displacement ke seedhe tanasub (directly proportional) mein ho.

book_ref.quote: The restoring force shall be directly proportional to the displacement from the mean position.

blocks.prompt:
26 In Hooke's law F = −kx for an oscillating spring, k depends on:
(Hooke's law F = −kx mein k kis cheez par munhasar hai?)
blocks.explanation: k spring constant hai jo spring ke material ki nature (fitrat) par munhasar hai (14.2).

book_ref.quote: The force and displacement should follow Hooke's law

blocks.prompt:
27 In the condition a ∝ −x for S.H.M, the negative sign shows that the acceleration is:
(S.H.M ki shart a ∝ −x mein manfi nishaan kya batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Manfi nishaan batata hai ke acceleration hamesha mean position ki taraf hai (14.2).

book_ref.quote: the negative sign indicates that acceleration is directed towards mean position

blocks.prompt:
28 The restoring force in S.H.M depends only on the:
(S.H.M mein restoring force sirf kis cheez par munhasar hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = −kx: restoring force sirf displacement par munhasar hai, inertia (jumood) par nahi.

book_ref.quote: The restoring force is not proportional to the inertia (mass) of the body; it depends only on the displacement

blocks.prompt:
29 What carries an oscillating body past its mean position?
(Oscillate karne wale jism ko mean position se aage kaun le jaata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jism ka inertia (jumood) usay mean position se aage le jaata hai.

book_ref.quote: The body must have inertia, which carries it past the mean position

blocks.prompt:
30 The motion of the recorder needle of an electrocardiogram is periodic but not S.H.M because:
(Electrocardiogram ki needle ki motion periodic hai magar S.H.M nahi, kyun?)

options.text: restoring force hamesha displacement ke proportional nahi
is ki koi mean position nahi
is mein koi restoring force hi nahi

blocks.explanation: Har periodic vibration S.H.M nahi; ECG mein restoring force hamesha displacement ke proportional nahi hoti.

book_ref.quote: An electrocardiogram traces the periodic pattern of a beating heart

blocks.prompt:
31 A spring of constant 200 N m⁻¹ is stretched 4 cm. The restoring force on the body is:
(200 N m⁻¹ wala spring 4 cm khencha gaya. Jism par restoring force kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: F = −kx = −200 × 0.04 = −8 N; manfi nishaan yani mean position ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: Consider a body of mass 'm' attached with a spring of spring constant 'k' lying on smooth horizontal surface

blocks.prompt:
32 A mass on a spring, released at A, crosses the mean position O because of:
(Spring par laga mass A se chhorne par mean position O se aage kyun nikal jaata hai?)

options.text: spring constant ka sifar ho jaana

blocks.explanation: Chhorne par jism O ki taraf aata hai aur inertia ki wajah se aage B tak chala jaata hai.

book_ref.quote: it will move towards 'O' and will cross the mean position O due to inertia

blocks.prompt:
33 A 0.5 kg mass on a spring of constant 40 N m⁻¹ is at x = +3 cm. Its acceleration is:
(0.5 kg mass 40 N m⁻¹ spring par x = +3 cm par hai. Us ka acceleration kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The negative sign shows that acceleration and displacement are always in opposite direction

blocks.prompt:
34 The mathematical form of simple harmonic motion is:
(Simple harmonic motion ki riyazi shakal kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: a = −(k/m)x se a ∝ −x: acceleration displacement ke proportional aur mean position ki taraf.

book_ref.quote: It shows that acceleration of the body executing S.H.M is always directly proportional to the displacement

blocks.prompt:
35 The spring constant k depends upon:
(Spring constant k kis cheez par munhasar hai?)
blocks.explanation: k spring ki nature (shakal aur banawat) par munhasar hai.

book_ref.quote: where 'k' is spring constant depending upon the nature (physical shape and structure of a spring)

blocks.prompt:
36 For a mass-spring system, the angular frequency ω is:
(Mass-spring system ki angular frequency ω kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: a = −(k/m)x ko a = −ω²x se milane par ω² = k/m, yani ω = √(k/m).

book_ref.quote: T is the reciprocal of f = (1/2π)√(k/m)

blocks.prompt:
37 The time period of a mass-spring system is:
(Mass-spring system ka time period kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: T = 1/f aur f = (1/2π)√(k/m), is liye T = 2π√(m/k).

book_ref.quote: T is the reciprocal of f = (1/2π)√(k/m), so m/k comes under the root

blocks.prompt:
38 If the mass on a spring is made four times, its time period becomes:
(Spring par mass chaar guna kar diya jaye to time period kitna ho jaata hai?)
blocks.explanation: T ∝ √m; √4 = 2, is liye period do guna.

book_ref.quote: A heavier mass gives a longer period.

blocks.prompt:
39 A 2 kg mass oscillates on a spring of constant 50 N m⁻¹. Its time period is about:
(2 kg mass 50 N m⁻¹ spring par oscillate karta hai. Time period taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The last line should read T = 1/f = 2π√(m/k)

blocks.prompt:
40 Which is given as a real-world application of the S.H.M principle?
(S.H.M ke usool ka asal zindagi mein istemal kaun sa diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pendulum clock, musical instruments aur gaari ka suspension system S.H.M ke usool par chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Real world applications that utilize S.H.M principle include

blocks.prompt:
41 The first pendulum clock was patented in 1656 by:
(1656 mein pehli pendulum clock ka patent kis ne liya?)
blocks.explanation: Dutch scientist Christiaan Huygens ne 1656 mein pehli pendulum clock patent ki.

book_ref.quote: Christiaan Huygens patented the first pendulum clock in 1656

blocks.prompt:
42 A simple pendulum consists of a small heavy bob suspended by a:
(Simple pendulum mein chhota bhaari bob kis cheez se latka hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhota bhaari bob halki aur na khinchne wali (inextensible) dori se rigid support se latka hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A simple pendulum consists of a small heavy solid bob of mass m suspended from a rigid support

blocks.prompt:
43 For a simple pendulum displaced by angle θ, the restoring force is provided by:
(θ angle par hataye gaye simple pendulum mein restoring force kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: mg cosθ tension se balance hota hai; mg sinθ mean position ki taraf restoring force deta hai.

book_ref.quote: The component mg sinθ provides the necessary restoring force towards mean position

blocks.prompt:
44 In a simple pendulum, the component mg cosθ is cancelled by:
(Simple pendulum mein mg cosθ component ko kaun cancel karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: mg cosθ aur tension T dori ke saath ulti simt mein hain aur aik doosre ko cancel karte hain.

book_ref.quote: the component mg cosθ and tension T are along the same line but in opposite direction

blocks.prompt:
45 For small angles of a simple pendulum, sinθ may be replaced by:
(Simple pendulum ke chhote angles ke liye sinθ ki jagah kya likha ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhote angles ke liye sinθ ≈ θ (radians mein), is se a = −gθ.

book_ref.quote: For small angles sinθ ≈ θ (θ in radians)

blocks.prompt:
46 The approximation x ≈ arc length S for a simple pendulum holds when the angle is about:
(Simple pendulum mein x ≈ arc length S kab durust hai, jab angle taqreeban kitna ho?)
blocks.explanation: Jab angle chhota ho, taqreeban 10° ya kam, to x ≈ S.

book_ref.quote: when the angle is small (about 10 or less)

blocks.prompt:
47 For a simple pendulum of small amplitude, the acceleration is a =
(Chhote amplitude wale simple pendulum ka acceleration kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: a = −(g/ℓ)x; g/ℓ constant hai, is liye a ∝ −x aur motion S.H.M hai.

book_ref.quote: This is the mathematical from of S.H.M and it is concluded that the motion of a simple pendulum is S.H.M.

blocks.prompt:
48 A simple pendulum is 2.45 m long. Taking g = 9.8 m s⁻², its time period is about:
(Simple pendulum 2.45 m lamba hai. g = 9.8 m s⁻² lein to time period taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The above expression shows that the time period of simple pendulum is directly proportional to the square root

blocks.prompt:
49 The time period of a simple pendulum (small amplitude) is independent of:
(Simple pendulum ka time period (chhota amplitude) kis cheez se azaad hai?)
blocks.explanation: T = 2π√(ℓ/g) mein m nahi; period bob ke mass aur amplitude se azaad hai.

book_ref.quote: The time period of motion of the pendulum is independent of the mass m of the bob and amplitude.

blocks.prompt:
50 If the length of a simple pendulum is made four times, its time period becomes:
(Simple pendulum ki lambai chaar guna kar di jaye to time period kitna ho jaata hai?)
blocks.explanation: T ∝ √ℓ; √4 = 2, is liye T do guna.

book_ref.quote: inversely proportional to the square root of acceleration due to gravity

blocks.prompt:
51 A second pendulum is one whose time period is:
(Second pendulum woh hai jis ka time period kitna ho?)
blocks.explanation: Jo pendulum aik vibration do second mein kare (T = 2 s) woh second pendulum hai.

book_ref.quote: A pendulum that completes one vibration in two seconds

blocks.prompt:
52 If a pendulum is taken to a place where g is smaller, its time period:
(Pendulum ko aisi jagah le jaya jaye jahan g kam ho to time period:)
blocks.explanation: T ∝ 1/√g; g kam to period zyada.

book_ref.quote: A pendulum is shifted from Lahore to Karachi will its time period change?

blocks.prompt:
53 The word 'pendulum' comes from a Latin word meaning:
(Lafz 'pendulum' kis Latin lafz se hai jis ka matlab hai:)
blocks.explanation: Pendulum Latin lafz pendulus se hai jis ka matlab latakna (hanging) hai.

book_ref.quote: Pendulum is derived from Latin word Pendulus means hanging.

blocks.prompt:
54 A pendulum 0.80 m long has a time period of 1.80 s. The value of g at that place is about:
(0.80 m lambe pendulum ka time period 1.80 s hai. Us jagah g taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The simple pendulum can be used to determine the gravitational acceleration at a particular location.

blocks.prompt:
55 Taking g = 9.8 m s⁻², the length of a pendulum with time period 1.5 s is about:
(g = 9.8 m s⁻² lein to 1.5 s time period wale pendulum ki lambai taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Also find its frequency at a place where the value of g is taken to be 9.8 m s⁻²

blocks.prompt:
56 While measuring the time period of a simple pendulum, a small amplitude is used because:
(Simple pendulum ka time period naapte waqt chhota amplitude kyun liya jaata hai?)

options.text: sinθ ≈ θ sirf chhote angles par durust hai, tab hi T = 2π√(ℓ/g) lagta hai
bara amplitude bob ko bhaari kar deta hai
bare amplitude par g sifar ho jaata hai
dori sirf chhote amplitude par khinchti hai

blocks.explanation: T = 2π√(ℓ/g) ki derivation mein sinθ ≈ θ aur x ≈ S istemal hote hain jo sirf chhote angles par durust hain.

book_ref.quote: While measuring the time period of a simple pendulum it is recommended to take small amplitude, why?

blocks.prompt:
57 A pendulum of fixed length is taken from the Earth to the Moon, where g is smaller. Its time period:
(Muqarrar lambai ka pendulum Zameen se Chaand par le jaya jaye jahan g kam hai. Time period:)
blocks.explanation: T = 2π√(ℓ/g); Chaand par g kam, is liye period lamba.

book_ref.quote: Would the time period of a simple pendulum be same on Earth and moon

blocks.text: 14.4 Simple Harmonic Motion and Uniform Circular Motion

blocks.prompt:
58 When a particle moves in a circle with uniform angular velocity, its projection on a diameter:
(Jab particle yaksaan angular velocity se circle mein ghoomta hai to diameter par us ka projection:)
blocks.explanation: Uniform circular motion ka diameter par projection S.H.M karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It has been observed that when a particle moves in a circular path, its projection on diameter of the circle executes S.H.M.

blocks.prompt:
59 In the turntable experiment, which part executes S.H.M?
(Turntable wale tajrube mein S.H.M kaun karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gend uniform circular motion karti hai; screen par us ka saaya S.H.M karta hai.

book_ref.quote: A beam of light casts a shadow of the ball on the screen

blocks.prompt:
60 For a particle moving on a circle of radius x₀ with angular velocity ω, its linear velocity is directed:
(x₀ radius ke circle par ω se ghoomte particle ki linear velocity kis rukh hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: P par linear velocity tangent (mamaas) ke rukh hoti hai, vₚ = rω.

book_ref.quote: Its linear velocity at point P is along the tangent

blocks.prompt:
61 The instantaneous displacement of the projection Q of a particle on a circle is:
(Circle par particle ke projection Q ka instantaneous displacement kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tikon POQ se x/x₀ = cos θ, θ = ωt, is liye x = x₀ cos ωt.

book_ref.quote: the angle which the radius OP sweeps out in time t is θ = ωt

blocks.prompt:
62 The instantaneous velocity of the projection Q equals:
(Projection Q ki instantaneous velocity kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Q ufuqi (horizontal) vibrate karta hai, is liye us ki velocity vₚ ka horizontal component hai.

book_ref.quote: the line PR is the horizontal component of velocity vₚ of the particle

blocks.prompt:
63 A body in S.H.M has ω = 5 rad s⁻¹ and amplitude 0.10 m. Its speed at x = 0.06 m is:
(S.H.M mein jism ka ω = 5 rad s⁻¹ aur amplitude 0.10 m hai. x = 0.06 m par speed kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: Eq. (14.13) should read v = ω√(x₀² − x²)

blocks.prompt:
64 A body in S.H.M has amplitude 0.04 m and ω = 15 rad s⁻¹. Its maximum speed is:
(S.H.M mein jism ka amplitude 0.04 m aur ω = 15 rad s⁻¹ hai. Zyada se zyada speed kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: v_max = x₀ω = 0.04 × 15 = 0.60 m s⁻¹, mean position par.

book_ref.quote: It may be noted that at mean position x = 0 and velocity is maximum.

blocks.prompt:
65 The expressions for time period, displacement, velocity and acceleration of the projection are:
(Projection ke time period, displacement, velocity aur acceleration ke formulas:)

options.text: circle mein ghoomte particle par bhi laagu
kisi asal jism par kabhi durust nahi

blocks.explanation: Yeh formulas projection ke saath circle mein ghoomte particle par bhi laagu hain.

book_ref.quote: The expressions such as time period, displacement, velocity and acceleration which are true for projection

blocks.prompt:
66 The acceleration aₚ of a particle in uniform circular motion is directed:
(Uniform circular motion mein particle ka acceleration aₚ kis rukh hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: aₚ centripetal hai: centre ki taraf; us ka horizontal component Q ka acceleration hai.

book_ref.quote: Acceleration aₚ of the particle at point P is directed towards the centre of the circle

blocks.prompt:
67 A particle moves on a circle with period 2 s. The acceleration of its projection at x = 0.1 m is about:
(Particle 2 s period se circle par ghoomta hai. x = 0.1 m par projection ka acceleration taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: This expression is the mathematical condition of S.H.M

blocks.prompt:
68 A body in S.H.M has amplitude 0.02 m and ω = 10 rad s⁻¹. The magnitude of its maximum acceleration is:
(S.H.M mein jism ka amplitude 0.02 m aur ω = 10 rad s⁻¹ hai. Zyada se zyada acceleration ki miqdaar kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: |a|max = x₀ω² = 0.02 × 100 = 2 m s⁻², extreme positions par.

book_ref.quote: As particle is moving in the circle with uniform angular frequency ω

blocks.prompt:
69 A 0.25 kg mass on a spring of constant 25 N m⁻¹ is at x = 0.04 m. Its acceleration is:
(0.25 kg mass 25 N m⁻¹ spring par x = 0.04 m par hai. Us ka acceleration kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: A 0.2 kg mass is attached to a spring with a spring constant of 10 N m⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
70 The angle θ = ωt that specifies the displacement and the direction of motion of a point in S.H.M is called:
(S.H.M mein displacement aur motion ki simt batane wala angle θ = ωt kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: θ = ωt jo x aur motion ki simt batata hai phase (marhala) kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: The angle θ = ωt which specifies the displacements x as well as the direction of motion

blocks.prompt:
71 Phase is the quantity that shows the:
(Phase kis cheez ko zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Phase oscillator ki motion ki haalat batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Phase is the quantity which shows the state of motion of an oscillator.

blocks.prompt:
72 The phase constant φ in x = x₀ cos(ωt + φ) depends on the:
(x = x₀ cos(ωt + φ) mein phase constant φ kis par munhasar hai?)
